target.class_name: Anh văn chuyên ngành Cơ khí
target.lesson_title: Chapter 2: Safety at Work — An toàn lao động

exam.title: Kiểm tra từ vựng Chapter 2: Safety at Work

questions.question: Which English word means “kính bảo hộ”?
questions.explanation: safety goggles: Provide protection to the eyes.

questions.question: Which English word means “dây đai an toàn (chống rơi ngã)”?
questions.explanation: safety harness: Avoids the worker falling.

questions.question: What does slip mean?
options: căng cơ, giãn cơ (nói về muscle)
questions.explanation: slip = trượt, tuột (tay).

questions.question: Which English word means “bong gân”?
questions.explanation: sprain: Damage to one or more ligaments in a joint, often caused by trauma.

questions.question: What does risk mean?
questions.explanation: risk = rủi ro, nguy cơ.

questions.question: What does injuries mean?
questions.explanation: injuries = chấn thương.

questions.question: Which English word means “biển cảnh báo nguy hiểm (warning sign)”?
questions.explanation: hazard sign: A safety sign which warns you of danger.

questions.question: Which English word means “miếng đệm bảo vệ đầu gối”?
questions.explanation: knee pads: Protect knees on the ground while working.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Protect ears against noise.
questions.explanation: ear protectors = chụp tai chống ồn.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A safety sign which tells you what you must do.
questions.explanation: mandatory sign = biển bắt buộc.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Someone who works for a skilled person for a particular period.
questions.explanation: apprentice = người học việc, thợ học nghề.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Protects the head from accidental injury.
questions.explanation: safety helmet = mũ bảo hộ.

questions.question: What does pit mean?
options: hố làm việc dưới gầm xe
questions.explanation: pit = hố làm việc dưới gầm xe.

questions.question: Which English word means “biển phòng cháy chữa cháy”?
questions.explanation: fire safety sign: A safety sign which shows where fire equipment and fire alarms are.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Handles heavy materials and protects the back.
questions.explanation: dorsal belt = đai lưng bảo vệ lưng.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Too much use of physical or mental energy; hard work.
questions.explanation: overexertion = gắng sức quá mức.

questions.question: Which English word means “tạp dề bảo hộ (yếm hàn)”?
questions.explanation: protective apron: Protects the body against welding work.

questions.question: Which English word means “khẩu trang, mặt nạ chống bụi và khí độc”?
questions.explanation: protective mask: Protects from inhaling harmful air particles as dusts, vapours, fumes and gases.

questions.question: What does assembly point mean?
options: hố làm việc dưới gầm xe
questions.explanation: assembly point = điểm tập trung (khi sơ tán).

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Protect the feet from accidental injury.
questions.explanation: safety shoes = giày bảo hộ.

questions.question: Which English word means “phòng thay đồ có tủ cá nhân”?
questions.explanation: locker room: A room for changing clothes.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A safety sign which tells you what you must not do.
questions.explanation: prohibition sign = biển cấm.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A safety sign which shows safe places, such as an exit or first aid.
questions.explanation: general safety sign = biển chỉ dẫn an toàn chung.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Handle heavy materials such as breeze-blocks, beams and avoid injuries.
questions.explanation: safety gloves = găng tay bảo hộ.

questions.question: Which English word means “không gian hẹp, kín (hầm, bồn, khoang…)”?
questions.explanation: confined areas: A space with limited entry that is not suitable for people.
